headline: Tawhid Hridoy scores double century in South Africa
summary: The Bangladesh 'A' skipper joins Mushfiqur Rahim and Shakib Al Hasan as the only Bangladeshi batters to hit a first-class double ton abroad.
details: Bangladesh 'A' captain Tawhid Hridoy smashed a brilliant double century against South Africa 'A' during the second four-day match at NWC Oval in Potchefstroom.
Hridoy reached his milestone off 335 balls, hitting 22 fours and a six. This marks his second double century in first-class cricket.
The 24-year-old has now joined an elite list of Bangladesh batters to score first-class double centuries abroad, alongside Mushfiqur Rahim and Shakib Al Hasan.
Hridoy's innings helped Bangladesh 'A' reach 471 for six by the end of the day, trailing South Africa 'A's first-innings total of 512 by 41 runs.
The match is on the third day of the second four-day match, and Mohammad Saifuddin contributed a strong 87 off 171 balls.
Jaker Ali also narrowly missed a century, scoring 94 off 168 balls.
caption:
A historic milestone! Tawhid Hridoy becomes one of only three Bangladeshi batters to score a first-class double century abroad.

Bangladesh 'A' captain Tawhid Hridoy smashed a brilliant double century against South Africa 'A' during the second four-day match at NWC Oval in Potchefstroom.

Hridoy reached his milestone off 335 balls, hitting 22 fours and a six. This marks his second double century in first-class cricket.

The 24-year-old has now joined an elite list of Bangladesh batters to score first-class double centuries abroad, alongside Mushfiqur Rahim and Shakib Al Hasan.

Hridoy's innings helped Bangladesh 'A' reach 471 for six by the end of the day, trailing South Africa 'A's first-innings total of 512 by 41 runs.

The match is on the third day of the second four-day match, and Mohammad Saifuddin contributed a strong 87 off 171 balls.

Jaker Ali also narrowly missed a century, scoring 94 off 168 balls.

headline_marked: Demra: [[Gunshots fired at BNP leader's house]] led by Chhatra Dal leader
headline: Demra: Gunshots fired at BNP leader's house led by Chhatra Dal leader
summary: The residence of SM Reza Chowdhury Selim, Demra Thana BNP convener, was targeted in a shooting incident in Dhaka.
details: Gunshots were fired at the home of SM Reza Chowdhury Selim, the convener of the Demra Thana BNP, in the capital's Demra area.
The attack was reportedly led by a leader of the Chhatra Dal, the student wing of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP).
The incident has caused tension in the local area as political figures are targeted in their own residences.
caption:
